hero.caption: Drawing of a basket of shield bosses found within the Myklebust viking ship in Nordfjordeid, Norway, from the Illustreret Norges historie (1885). The grave mound "Rundehogjen" or "Lorange's mound" in Nordfjordeid conceiled the burned remains of the "Myklebust" ship, excavated in 1874. Among artifacts found in the center of the mound, was a bronze pan and a pile of iron bulges from shields.
